title: Roasted Moong Dal Laddoo
steps: Wash raw yellow moong dal thoroughly and drain it well.
Dry roast the moong dal on medium heat until it turns lightly golden brown and smells roasted.
Let it cool slightly, then grind it into a fine powder.
Heat 1½ tbsp ghee in a pan and add the powdered moong dal. Roast well on low-medium heat until fragrant and the colour changes to a light brown.

Take the pan off the heat and let the mixture cool slightly. Add 2 tbsp unsweetened almond butter and zero-calorie sweetener as per taste. I used around 2 tbsp sweetener, but you can adjust it to your preference.
Mix everything well until it comes together. If the mixture feels too dry and the laddoos aren’t binding, add a little more almond butter.
Divide the mixture into 10 portions and shape them into laddoos.
assumptions: The creator’s figures are approximate; they also give about 3.7 g fibre per laddoo.
